title: Dynamic Matching with Abandonment: Optimal Guarantees via Static Priority Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.12991v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study stochastic dynamic matching with abandonment, a fundamental model in which agents of different types arrive over time, may abandon the market while waiting, and can be matched in pairs for rewards that depend on their types. No online policy can guarantee more than $0.5$ of the omniscient benchmark, which knows all arrival and departure times. Whether this guarantee is achievable has been a central open problem, even in special cases. We resolve this problem by showing that, on every instance, a simple static priority policy, which is computable in polynomial time, earns at least $0.5$ of the omniscient benchmark. translated_title: 带放弃的动态匹配：通过静态优先级策略实现最优保证
translated_abstract: 我们研究带放弃的随机动态匹配，这是一个基础模型：不同类型的智能体随时间到达，可能在等待期间离开市场，并且可以成对匹配以获得取决于其类型的奖励。没有任何在线策略能够保证超过全知基准（即知晓所有到达和离开时间的基准）的 0.5。这一保证是否可以实现一直是一个核心的开放性问题，即使在特殊情况下也是如此。我们通过证明一个简单的静态优先级策略（可在多项式时间内计算）在每个实例上都能获得至少全知基准的 0.5 来解决这一问题。这确立了最优竞争比恰好为 0.5，将此前一般模型下的最佳保证 0.192 [Li et al. 2026; Collina et al. 2020] 提升至最优水平。我们的分析基于一个关键的随机结果，即一个关于来自给定类型集合的某个智能体是…的新概率下界（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明了简单的静态优先级策略在带放弃的动态匹配问题中能保证获得全知基准的至少0.5，从而确立了最优竞争比恰好为0.5，解决了该领域长期存在的开放性问题，并将此前最佳保证0.192大幅提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a simple, polynomial-time computable static priority policy earns at least 0.5 of the omniscient benchmark on every instance of dynamic matching with abandonment, establishing that the optimal competitive ratio is exactly 0.5 and resolving a central open problem, improving upon the previous best guarantee of 0.192.
